dimensions.reason: The Permit grants a finite 100-token standing allowance to spender 0x3333333333333333333333333333333333333333, while the deadline only limits signature submission, not allowance duration after submission.
The declared cap is 100 LAB-USD against a 5,000 LAB-USD same-token balance, with current allowance 0, limiting conditional exposure at this snapshot to about 2% of that balance.
Future Permit submission and consumption were not simulated or executed, so actual asset movement remains unverified.
The spender has no observed code and no verified identity, reputation checks are disabled, and the request-bound signing network was not established despite matching domain and nonce checks.
Contract owner and pause controls are missing and token intelligence is disabled, so protocol controls and exit behavior cannot be assessed.
The off-chain purpose is unverified, leaving inducement or social-engineering context unassessed.
